preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m of the land plot are between 3 and 300 inclusive.
The target time t is a positive integer up to 10^9.
The time costs for flat, ascent, and descent moves are positive integers up to 100.

preconditions.expression: len(heights) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in heights)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n rows, each with m height values.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= h <= 10**6 for row in heights for h in row)
preconditions.description: All height values are positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c2 <= m
postconditions.description: The output coordinates (r1, c1) and (r2, c2) are valid 1-based indices within the grid.
The upper-left corner is strictly above and to the left of the lower-right corner.
The rectangle sides consist of at least 3 squares.

postconditions.expression: abs(compute_track_time(r1, c1, r2, c2, heights, tp, tu, td) - t) == min(abs(compute_track_time(r, c, R, C, heights, tp, tu, td) - t) for r in range(1, n-1) for c in range(1, m-1) for R in range(r+2, n+1) for C in range(c+2, m+1))
postconditions.description: The selected rectangle minimizes the absolute difference between its clockwise traversal time and the target time t among all valid rectangles.
